facts.fact: NIRA has registered more than 1.5 million citizens since 2023, about 7.6% of the 19.7 million population (share computed from the population held), against a target of 15 million by 2029, says the Hiiraan report quoting the interior minister.
Somalia's National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) runs the registration and issuance of the national ID, which it launched as eAqoonsi in September 2023, says the Hiiraan report.

SOM.note: No public register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: Somalia launched its first digital national ID system, eAqoonsi, through NIRA in September 2023 and has registered more than 1.5 million citizens, says the Hiiraan report.
